beats.narration_text: Liam, in for Bear — part two of the HAI wordmark. Type as motion: tracking breathe where letter-spacing expands and contracts, a typewriter with a terracotta caret, a clip-path wipe that reveals the full marquee, and a highlight sweep — a light band passing across the ink once. These are type-native moves.

Let's recap with Claude. Tracking breathe expands to wide then contracts — the wordmark inhales and exhales through its own letter-spacing. Typewriter, glyph by glyph, terracotta caret — classic read but watch whether it respects the two-word structure. Mask wipe reveals the full marquee. Highlight sweep passes once — the restraint is correct.

Your turn. Paste this: build me a typewriter animation for HUMANITARIANS AI — one glyph per tick, terracotta caret — and then tell me whether the caret should blink between glyphs or stay solid. Blink says terminal. Solid says confidence.
